title: OSF UI View Manifest
description: Schema for views/<modId>/<viewName>/manifest.json. Mirrors src/runtime/ViewManifest.cpp. Unknown keys are allowed. Bridge protocol 2.0.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint; ignored by the runtime.

title.description: Friendly name for view. Defaults to the qualified id.

description.description: One-line blurb shown in catalogs. Defaults to empty.

accent.description: Optional accent used by platform chrome such as the first-load handoff.

entry.description: Relative path to the entry HTML, inside the view folder. Absolute paths and any '..' component are rejected.

width.description: Initial view width. The d3d12 compositor resizes the view to the screen aspect at runtime; author responsive CSS.

transparent.description: Render with an alpha channel so the game shows through unpainted areas.

kind.description: Surface kind. menu = modal overlay (may capture input, single-menu stack); hud = passive overlay over gameplay (never captures input, pauses, or focuses). Unknown values fall back to menu.

capturesInput.description: Menu-only: while this is the top open menu, route input into the page. Forced false for HUDs.

pausesGame.description: Menu-only: pause the simulation while this is the top open menu. Forced false for HUDs.

openOnStart.description: HUD: the author DEFAULT for automatic start at game launch — the player's per-HUD choice in Mod Settings overrides it.

order.description: HUD-only within-band paint order (clamped 0..999): higher draws on top of other HUDs. Ignored for menus.

hub.description: List this view in catalogs (the `osfui/views` state key / the Mods surface). false = hidden utility view;

debugOnly.description: When true, this view is kept out of the mod menu list unless devMode is enabled in OSF UI's config.json. It still loads and can be opened by id. Intended for built-in developer tools.

readySignal.description: When true, first open waits for the page to call osfui.markReady() (which sends the `view.ready` send endpoint) rather than main-frame load completion. Use it when "loaded" and "has something worth showing" are different moments — a HUD that must fetch state first. Requires permissions.nativeBridge. A 15-second post-load timeout offers retry instead of trapping the player. (2.0 views use markReady; the temporary 1.x facade retains viewReady through 2.0.x.)

targetVersion.description: The OSF UI version this view was authored against (e.g. "2.0.0"). A target NEWER than the running host is advisory and badges 'needs update' on the Mods surface. During 2.0.x, a declared target BELOW 2.0 selects the temporary 1.x facade and raises a persistent 2.1.0 removal warning. An UNDECLARED targetVersion is deliberately treated as current rather than guessing which helper shape the page expects.

permissions.description: Capability grants. Everything defaults to deny.

nativeBridge.description: Inject window.osfui — the four verbs (send / request / on / state) and the page-initiated handshake. If false, no bridge is injected at all and the page runs purely client-side; osfui.available is then false and osfui.request() rejects with "no-bridge" rather than hanging.

filesystem.description: Reserved; no implementation enforces this yet.

network.description: Reserved; forced off with a warning if set true.
